95	func _setup_input() -> void:
96		var actions := {"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT], "move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT], "jump": [KEY_SPACE], "pause": [KEY_ESCAPE, KEY_P], "restart": [KEY_R], "confirm": [KEY_ENTER], "menu": [KEY_M], "water": [KEY_W], "mute_music": [KEY_N], "mute_sfx": [KEY_B]}
97		for action in actions:
98			if InputMap.has_action(action):
99				continue
100			InputMap.add_action(action)
101			for key in actions[action]:
102				var event := InputEventKey.new()
103				event.physical_keycode = key
104				InputMap.action_add_event(action, event)
105	
106	func _add_solid(rect: Rect2) -> void:
107		var body := StaticBody2D.new()
108		body.position = rect.position + rect.size / 2
109		body.collision_layer = 1
110		body.collision_mask = 2
111		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
112		shape.size = rect.size
113		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
114		collision.shape = shape
115		body.add_child(collision)
116		add_child(body)
117	
118	func _add_area(rect: Rect2, layer: int, spikes: bool) -> Area2D:
119		var area := Area2D.new()
120		area.position = rect.position
121		area.collision_layer = layer
122		area.collision_mask = 2
123		if spikes:
124			# Three exact triangular trigger silhouettes; no oversized invisible box.
125			for i in range(3):
126				var triangle := CollisionPolygon2D.new()
127				var x := float(i) * rect.size.x / 3.0
128				triangle.polygon = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, rect.size.y), Vector2(x + 4, 0), Vector2(x + 8, rect.size.y)])
129				area.add_child(triangle)
130		else:
131			var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
132			var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
133			shape.size = rect.size
134			collision.shape = shape
135			collision.position = rect.size / 2.0
136			area.add_child(collision)
137		add_child(area)
138		return area
139	
140	func start_session() -> void:
141		if state == State.PLAYING:
142			return
143		deaths = 0
144		restart_attempt()
145	
146	func restart_attempt() -> void:
147		state = State.PLAYING
148		elapsed = 0.0
149		retry_remaining = 0.0
150		# Area2D overlaps are physics-step snapshots. Discard pre-teleport contacts
151		# until the broadphase has observed the reset, preventing a phantom second death.
152		contact_settle_ticks = 2
153		player.reset_at(Vector2(level.spawn[0], level.spawn[1]))
154		player.enabled = true
155		camera.position = Vector2(320, 180)
156		rescued_count = 0
157		locked_cue_ticks = 0
158		saved_popup_ticks = 0
159		fire_active = true
160		extinguish_ticks = 0
161		water_ticks = 0
162		flights.clear()
163		for s in survivors:
164			s.rescued = false
165			s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", true)

167	# Blocking-fire height in px: full until hosing starts, then shrinks linearly to 0
168	# over EXTINGUISH_TICKS (half by 2 s). Drives both the flame visual and the kill-zone.
169	func fire_height() -> float:
170		if not fire_active or not level.has("blocking_fire"):
171			return 0.0
172		var full: float = float(level.blocking_fire[3])
173		if extinguish_ticks > 0:
174			return full * float(extinguish_ticks) / float(EXTINGUISH_TICKS)
175		return full

177	func set_paused(value: bool) -> void:
178		if value and state == State.PLAYING:
179			state = State.PAUSED
180			player.enabled = false
181		elif not value and state == State.PAUSED:
182			state = State.PLAYING
183			player.enabled = true
184			player.require_jump_release = true
185			player.jump_request_tick = -1000
186	
187	func _on_focus_lost() -> void:
188		if not test_mode:
189			set_paused(true)
190	
191	func resolve_contacts(fatal: bool, finished: bool) -> void:
192		if state != State.PLAYING:
193			return
194		if fatal:
195			state = State.DYING
196			deaths += 1
197			retry_remaining = 0.55
198			player.enabled = false
199			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
200			if death_reason == "The fire got you.":
201				player.show_pose("burned")
202				play_sfx("burn")
203				retry_remaining = FIRE_DEATH_HOLD  # burned pose + DEVASTATED pop-up stay up; R skips the wait
204		elif finished:
205			state = State.COMPLETE
206			last_finish_time = elapsed
207			player.enabled = false
208			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
209			player.show_pose("celebrate")
210			complete_ticks = 0
211			play_sfx("win")

213	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
214		if state == State.DYING:
215			retry_remaining -= delta
216			if retry_remaining <= 0:
217				restart_attempt()
218		elif state == State.PLAYING:
219			elapsed += delta
220			var fell := player.position.y > float(level.fall_y)
221			var timed_out := elapsed >= float(level.time_limit)
222			var hit_fire := false
223			for hazard in hazard_areas:
224				if hazard.overlaps_body(player):
225					hit_fire = true
226			# The blocking fire is lethal + blocks the path until FULLY hosed. Its kill-zone
227			# shrinks from the top with the flames (see fire_height), but the base stays lethal
228			# until the fire is completely out -- so walking in mid-extinguish still kills.
229			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
230				var bf0: Array = level.blocking_fire
231				var fire_top: float = (float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3])) - fire_height()
232				var half_w: float = Player.BOX.x / 2.0
233				if player.position.x + half_w > float(bf0[0]) and player.position.x - half_w < float(bf0[0]) + float(bf0[2]) and player.position.y > fire_top and player.position.y - Player.BOX.y < float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3]):
234					hit_fire = true
235			var fatal := fell or timed_out or hit_fire
236			if fatal:
237				death_reason = "Out of time!" if timed_out else ("You fell." if fell else "The fire got you.")
238			# Hose: tap W within range of the blocking fire -> water pours ~4 s -> fire out.
239			near_fire = false
240			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
241				var bf: Array = level.blocking_fire
242				near_fire = player.is_on_floor() and player.position.x > float(bf[0]) - 50.0 and player.position.x < float(bf[0]) + float(bf[2]) + 10.0 and player.position.y < float(bf[1]) + float(bf[3]) + 20.0 and player.position.y > float(bf[1]) - 40.0
243				var water: bool = player.test_water_pressed if player.test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("water")
244				if player.test_control:
245					player.test_water_pressed = false
246				if water and near_fire and extinguish_ticks == 0:
247					extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS
248					water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60  # water lingers ~1 s after it is out
249					play_sfx("hose")
250			if extinguish_ticks > 0:
251				extinguish_ticks -= 1
252				if extinguish_ticks == 0:
253					fire_active = false
254			if water_ticks > 0:
255				water_ticks -= 1
256			player.hosing = water_ticks > 0
257			# Touch to rescue -- only while NOT in a fatal state, so you can't rescue THROUGH fire.
258			if not fatal:
259				for s in survivors:
260					if not s.rescued and s.area.overlaps_body(player):
261						s.rescued = true
262						s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
263						rescued_count += 1
264						player.rescued = rescued_count
265						player.bag_types.append(s.type)
266						player.bag_in_flight += 1
267						player.play_actions([["grab", GRAB_TICKS], ["toss", TOSS_UP_TICKS]])
268						flights.append({"type": s.type, "from": Vector2(s.x, s.y), "t": 0})
269						play_sfx("rescue")
270						saved_popup_ticks = 55
271						saved_popup_pos = Vector2(s.x - 18.0, s.y - 34.0)
272			var all_rescued := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
273			var at_exit := goal.overlaps_body(player) and player.is_on_floor()
274			if at_exit and not all_rescued:
275				locked_cue_ticks = 45  # flash "rescue everyone first"
276			if locked_cue_ticks > 0:
277				locked_cue_ticks -= 1
278			if saved_popup_ticks > 0:
279				saved_popup_ticks -= 1
280			if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
281				contact_settle_ticks -= 1
282			else:
283				# Exit completes only when BOTH survivors are rescued AND reached on foot.
284				# State machine unchanged; only the COMPLETE condition gains "both rescued".
285				resolve_contacts(fatal, at_exit and all_rescued)
286			camera.position.x = clampf(player.position.x + 100, 320, float(level.width) - 320)
287		if state == State.COMPLETE:
288			complete_ticks += 1
289		for fl in flights:
290			fl.t += 1
291			if fl.t == GRAB_TICKS:  # toss starts: launch from his raised hand, straight up
292				fl.launch = player.position + Vector2(0.0, -62.0)
293				fl.apex = fl.launch + Vector2(0.0, -TOSS_HEIGHT)
294			if fl.t >= GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS:
295				player.bag_in_flight = maxi(player.bag_in_flight - 1, 0)
296				player.queue_redraw()
297		flights = flights.filter(func(fl): return fl.t < GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS)
298		if is_instance_valid(hud):
299			hud.queue_redraw()
300		queue_redraw()  # refresh the level's own dynamic draw: survivors vanish, SAVED! animates, exit unlocks

302	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
303		if event is InputEventKey and event.echo:
304			return
305		if event.is_action_pressed("mute_music"):
306			_toggle_mute("Music")
307		elif event.is_action_pressed("mute_sfx"):
308			_toggle_mute("SFX")
309		elif event.is_action_pressed("confirm"):
310			if state in [State.MENU, State.COMPLETE]:
311				start_session()
312			elif state == State.PAUSED:
313				set_paused(false)
314		elif event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
315			set_paused(state != State.PAUSED)
316		elif event.is_action_pressed("restart") and state in [State.PLAYING, State.PAUSED, State.DYING]:

318		elif event.is_action_pressed("menu") and state in [State.PAUSED, State.COMPLETE]:
319			state = State.MENU

321		elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
322			if Rect2(220, 215, 200, 34).has_point(hud.get_local_mouse_position()):

329		if level.is_empty():
330			return
331		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
332		var ink := Color("25354a")
333		# All visual assets are original Godot vector drawing, not recovered art.
334		# The A1 cream sky, grid, and hills are replaced by the generated ENV-BG (see _ready).
335		# Burning buildings — decorative facades drawn BEHIND the ledges (no collision).
336		for b in level.get("buildings", []):
337			var bl := Rect2(b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3])
338			draw_rect(bl, Color("e0cdaf"))                                         # very light brown wall (contrast for dark figures)

2	# A5 controlled-value captures (CHANGE-BRIEF A4, TEST-REPORT "Controlled values"). Needs a window:
3	#   ~/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --path godot --script res://tests/capture_glow.gd
4	# Starts a real session, walks Extinguisho into hose range, presses W through Input so the hose
5	# pose and water are real, then for each controlled glow value: stops the driver's _process so it
6	# cannot overwrite the value, sets the uniform from code, waits for the frame to draw, saves the
7	# rendered viewport as PNG, and samples the three named texels P1-P3 (and the glow-2.0 clamp case).
8	# It is real engine output, not a headless log. Judging the captures is the human check.
9	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
10	var OUT: String = ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://").path_join("../a5/evidence/captures/")
11	const VALUES := [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0]
12	# Named texels in hose.png (CHANGE-BRIEF A4) and their file colours.
13	const PIXELS := {"P1": Vector2i(77, 49), "P2": Vector2i(51, 26), "P3": Vector2i(63, 6)}
14	var game: Node2D
15	
16	func _initialize() -> void:
17		call_deferred("run")
18	
19	func steps(n: int) -> void:
20		for i in range(n):
21			await physics_frame
22			await process_frame
23	
24	func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
25		var e := InputEventKey.new()
26		e.keycode = code
27		e.physical_keycode = code
28		e.pressed = pressed
29		Input.parse_input_event(e)
30	
31	func run() -> void:
32		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(OUT)
33		game = Game.new()
34		game.test_mode = true
35		root.add_child(game)
36		game.start_session()
37		game.player.position = Vector2(1220, 240)  # hose range, same spot as the tests
38		game.player.facing = 1.0
39		await steps(3)
40		key(KEY_W, true)
41		await steps(2)
42		key(KEY_W, false)
43		# Wait for the real hose pose: hosing true AND the 30-tick respawn stance over, so the sprite is
44		# hose.png and its anchor is the one the A4 texel mapping assumes. Then let the camera settle.
45		var guard := 0
46		while guard < 200 and not (game.player.hosing and game.player.pose == "hose"):
47			await steps(1)
48			guard += 1
49		if not (game.player.hosing and game.player.pose == "hose"):
50			push_error("hose pose never showed (hosing=%s pose=%s); nothing captured" % [game.player.hosing, game.player.pose])
51			quit(1)
52			return
53		await steps(5)
54		var player: CharacterBody2D = game.player
55		var sprite: Sprite2D = player.sprite
56		var driver: Node = player.get_node("HoseGlow")
57		var mat: ShaderMaterial = sprite.material
58		print("pose=%s facing=%d player=%s window=%s" % [player.pose, int(player.facing), player.position, get_root().size])
59		# `-- bag`: CHANGE-BRIEF F5. Rescues happen after the hose in this level, so the bag with a survivor
60		# in it is never on screen while he glows in normal play. For the controlled capture only, put a

extends CharacterBody2D

signal jumped  # emitted once per real jump (the session plays SFX-JUMP; sound never feeds back)

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
const HoseGlow = preload("res://features/player/hose_glow.gd")  # A5: glow material on `sprite`, driven from `hosing`
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var facing: float = 1.0
var rescued: int = 0  # survivors in the rescue bag (set by session; used for drawing)
var bag_types: Array = []  # survivor types riding in the bag, e.g. ["person","dog"] (set by session)
var jumps: int = 0
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false
var test_water_pressed: bool = false  # hose input hook for the scripted route / tests
# Extinguisho art: one static generated image per state, swapped in (visual only; never read by gameplay).
const ART_DIR := "res://art/character/"
const BOX := Vector2(20, 40)   # collision box; feet at the origin (CHARACTER-SHEET, collision option A)
const LAND_TICKS := 20         # landing pose holds this long after real air time (was 8: too fast to see)
const NOZZLE := Vector2(33, -27.5)  # hose nozzle tip in the hose pose (game px, facing right): the water starts here
# Rescue bag center per pose (game px, facing right): on his back at the hip, measured on each image.
const BAG := {"idle": Vector2(-10, -30), "respawn": Vector2(-13, -20), "run": Vector2(-8, -21),
	"jump_crouch": Vector2(-9, -30), "rising": Vector2(-10, -18), "falling": Vector2(-12, -16),
	"landing": Vector2(-8, -20), "hose": Vector2(-10, -19), "grab": Vector2(-10, -27),
	"toss": Vector2(-10, -31), "burned": Vector2(-10, -30), "celebrate": Vector2(-9, -27)}
var pose: String = "idle"
var art: Node2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures := {}
var anchors := {}
var jumped_this_air: bool = false
var air_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var was_on_floor: bool = true
var hosing: bool = false        # water is pouring (set by session)
var bag_in_flight: int = 0      # survivors still flying toward the bag (set by session); their heads appear on landing
var action_queue: Array = []    # timed poses that override movement, e.g. [["grab", 15], ["toss", 27]]
var action_cancel_on_move: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 1.0
	var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	shape.size = BOX
	var collider := CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = shape
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -BOX.y / 2.0)
	add_child(collider)
	var info: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART_DIR + "anchors.json"))
	anchors = info.anchors
	for state in anchors:
		textures[state] = load(ART_DIR + state + ".png")
	art = Node2D.new()
	art.show_behind_parent = true  # the code-drawn rescue bag stays on top of the art
	add_child(art)
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	art.add_child(sprite)
	show_pose("idle")
	add_child(HoseGlow.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `hosing` and writes the shader's `glow`

# Swap the state image. The anchor (bottom-center of the collision box in texture px)
# lands on the origin; the holder's negative x scale mirrors the art when facing left.
func show_pose(state: String) -> void:
	pose = state
	sprite.texture = textures[state]
	var a: Array = anchors[state]
	sprite.position = -Vector2(a[0], a[1])
	art.scale = Vector2(0.5 * facing, 0.5)
	queue_redraw()  # the bag follows the pose

# Timed state poses (grab, toss, respawn), played in order and held for their tick count.
func play_actions(steps: Array, cancel_on_move: bool = false) -> void:
	action_queue = steps.duplicate(true)
	action_cancel_on_move = cancel_on_move
	show_pose(action_queue[0][0])

func _update_pose() -> void:
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	if on_floor:
		if not was_on_floor and air_ticks > 10:
			land_ticks = LAND_TICKS
		air_ticks = 0
		jumped_this_air = false
	else:
		air_ticks += 1
	was_on_floor = on_floor
	if land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not action_queue.is_empty() and action_cancel_on_move and (absf(velocity.x) > 8.0 or not on_floor):
		action_queue.clear()
	if not action_queue.is_empty():
		show_pose(action_queue[0][0])
		action_queue[0][1] -= 1
		if action_queue[0][1] <= 0:
			action_queue.pop_front()
	elif not on_floor:
		# A jump is one flying kick all the way; walking off a ledge is the meditating fall.
		show_pose("rising" if jumped_this_air else "falling")
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		show_pose("landing")
	elif absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		show_pose("run")
	elif hosing:
		show_pose("hose")
	else:
		show_pose("idle")

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	require_jump_release = true
	test_jump_pressed = false
	jumps = 0
	rescued = 0
	bag_types.clear()
	jumped_this_air = false
	air_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	was_on_floor = true
	hosing = false
	bag_in_flight = 0
	play_actions([["respawn", 30]], true)  # snaps into the ready stance; any movement ends it
	queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		jumped_this_air = true
		jumped.emit()
	move_and_slide()
	position.x = maxf(position.x, 10.0)
	_update_pose()
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# The body is the generated art (sprite above). Only the rescue bag is still code-drawn:
	# the art has no bag, and rescued survivors ride in it (person or dog head per rescue).
	# Same drawing as Assignment 1, doubled, placed per pose on his back. Hidden until the
	# first rescue, so the empty bag doesn't cover the generated art.
	if bag_types.is_empty():
		return
	var f := facing                 # +1 right, -1 left
	var c: Vector2 = BAG.get(pose, BAG.idle)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 2), bag_dark)
	# rescued survivors ride in the bag — a clear head per rescue (grows as you save more)
	for i in range(bag_types.size() - bag_in_flight):
		var hx := (-1.0 + float(i) * 4.5) * f
		var hyy := -7.0
		if String(bag_types[i]) == "dog":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx-3, hyy-1), Vector2(hx-2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # left ear
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1), Vector2(hx+2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+3, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # right ear
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, Color("8a5a2b"))       # dog head
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, skin)                 # person head
			draw_rect(Rect2(hx - 3.0, hyy - 3.6, 6.0, 2.2), Color("3a2f1a"))  # hair
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

2	# A5 hose glow (CHANGE-BRIEF Part A): the shader's interface and the driver's rules, headless.
3	# The hosing state is driven through the real game loop and synthetic key events (W, R), never
4	# by calling the driver. The uniform is read every frame by a Sampler node whose process_priority
5	# is high, so it runs after every other _process in the frame (the driver included).
6	# Run at 30, 60 and 144 fps: scripts/run-test.sh test_hose_glow.gd <fps>.
7	# Revision 3: the hold is a breathing band 0.4..0.8 with a 1.0 s period instead of a flat 1.0;
8	# the hold assertions (in-band, maxima, period) and the ramp targets follow it.
9	# What this cannot see: pixels. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
10	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
11	const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/hose_glow.gdshader"
12	const DRIVER_PATH := "res://features/player/hose_glow.gd"
13	const RAMP := 0.25     # R3: ramp rate is 1/RAMP per game second
14	const BAND_LO := 0.4   # Revision 3: while hosing, glow breathes 0.6 + 0.2 sin(2π t) ...
15	const BAND_HI := 0.8
16	const PERIOD := 1.0    # ... with a 1.0 s period in game seconds
17	const EPS := 1e-5
18	const BAND_EPS := 1e-4   # membership tolerance for the band
19	const REACH_EPS := 0.01  # how close the sampled signal must come to 0.4 and 0.8 (sampling at 30 fps loses < 0.002)
20	var game: Node2D
21	var sampler: Sampler
22	var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
23	var failures := 0
24	
25	# Records {g: glow uniform, d: process delta, h: player.hosing} once per _process frame, after
26	# everyone else's _process (priority 100). It only reads; it never touches the driver.
27	class Sampler extends Node:
28		var game: Node2D
29		var samples: Array = []
30		func _process(delta: float) -> void:
31			if not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null or game.player.sprite == null:
32				return
33			var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
34			var g: float = float(mat.get_shader_parameter("glow")) if mat is ShaderMaterial else -1.0
35			samples.append({"g": g, "d": delta, "h": game.player.hosing})
36	
37	func _initialize() -> void:
38		call_deferred("run")
39	
40	func steps(n: int) -> void:
41		for i in range(n):
42			await physics_frame
43			await process_frame
44	
45	# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, the path test_keyboard.gd already proves reaches
46	# Input.is_action_just_pressed in physics (W) and _unhandled_input (R) headlessly.
47	func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
48		var event := InputEventKey.new()
49		event.keycode = code
50		event.physical_keycode = code
51		event.pressed = pressed
52		Input.parse_input_event(event)
53	
54	func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
55		results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
56		print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
57		if not condition:
58			failures += 1
59	
60	func fresh() -> void:
61		if is_instance_valid(game):
62			game.queue_free()
63			await process_frame
64		game = Game.new()
65		game.test_mode = true
66		root.add_child(game)
67		game.start_session()          # real input: player.test_control stays false
68		sampler.game = game
69		sampler.samples.clear()
70		game.player.position = Vector2(1220, 240)  # on B1-PW, in hose range (same spot as test_game.gd)
71		await steps(3)
72	
73	func S() -> Array:
74		return sampler.samples
75	
76	func in_band(g: float) -> bool:
77		return g >= BAND_LO - BAND_EPS and g <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS
78	
79	func zero(g: float) -> bool:
80		return is_zero_approx(g)
81	
82	func first_from(from: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
83		for i in range(from, S().size()):
84			if pred.call(S()[i]):
85				return i
86		return -1
87	
88	func last_before(limit: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
89		var found := -1
90		for i in range(0, limit):
91			if pred.call(S()[i]):
92				found = i
93		return found
94	
95	# Every step between a and b (inclusive) moves in `dir` (+1 up, -1 down), never backwards,
96	# and by at most delta / RAMP (+ EPS). Returns {ok, worst_step}.
97	func monotone(a: int, b: int, dir: float) -> Dictionary:
98		var ok := a >= 0 and b > a
99		var worst := 0.0
100		for i in range(a + 1, b + 1):
101			var step: float = (S()[i].g - S()[i - 1].g) * dir
102			var max_step: float = S()[i].d / RAMP + EPS
103			worst = maxf(worst, step)
104			if step < -EPS or step > max_step:
105				ok = false
106		return {"ok": ok, "worst_step": worst}
107	
108	func all_in_band(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
109		if a < 0 or b < a:
110			return false
111		for i in range(a, b + 1):
112			if not in_band(S()[i].g):
113				return false
114		return true
115	
116	# Indices of the strict local maxima of g in [a, b] (a > 0, b < size - 1). A tie with the next
117	# sample counts once, on the first of the pair (at 30 fps the peak at t = 0.25 s falls between
118	# two samples that are equal up to rounding).
119	func local_maxima(a: int, b: int) -> Array[int]:
120		var peaks: Array[int] = []
121		for i in range(maxi(a, 1), mini(b, S().size() - 2) + 1):
122			if S()[i].g > S()[i - 1].g and S()[i].g >= S()[i + 1].g:
123				peaks.append(i)
124		return peaks
125	
126	func min_max(a: int, b: int) -> Dictionary:
127		var lo := INF
128		var hi := -INF
129		for i in range(a, b + 1):
130			lo = minf(lo, S()[i].g)
131			hi = maxf(hi, S()[i].g)
132		return {"min": lo, "max": hi}
133	
134	func run() -> void:
135		sampler = Sampler.new()
136		sampler.process_priority = 100
137		root.add_child(sampler)
138	
139		# --- A2 / F4: the shader's interface, from the engine and from the source text ---
140		var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
141		var uniforms: Array = shader.get_shader_uniform_list()
142		var types := {}
143		var raw: Array = []
144		for u in uniforms:
145			types[String(u.name)] = int(u.type)
146			raw.append({"name": String(u.name), "type": int(u.type), "hint": int(u.hint), "hint_string": String(u.hint_string)})
147		check("shader-uniforms", uniforms.size() == 2 and types.get("glow", -1) == TYPE_FLOAT and types.get("glow_color", -1) == TYPE_COLOR,
148			{"uniforms": raw, "TYPE_FLOAT": TYPE_FLOAT, "TYPE_COLOR": TYPE_COLOR})
149		var src: String = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
150		var re_glow := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+float\\s+glow\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*0\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*0\\.0\\s*;")
151		var re_color := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+vec4\\s+glow_color\\s*:\\s*source_color\\s*=\\s*vec4\\(\\s*0\\.6\\s*,\\s*0\\.85\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*;")
152		check("shader-defaults", re_glow.search(src) != null and re_color.search(src) != null,
153			{"glow_default_line": re_glow.search(src) != null, "glow_color_default_line": re_color.search(src) != null, "source_bytes": src.length()})
154		var re_line := RegEx.create_from_string("COLOR\\.rgb\\s*=\\s*mix\\(\\s*COLOR\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow_color\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow\\s*\\)\\s*;")
155		check("colour-line", re_line.search(src) != null, {"a2_colour_line_present": re_line.search(src) != null})
156		var driver_param: String = load(DRIVER_PATH).PARAM
157		check("driver-param-declared", types.has(driver_param), {"driver_writes": driver_param, "shader_declares": types.keys()})
158	
159		# --- A2 / F5 / R8: where the material sits ---
160		await fresh()
161		var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
162		var mat_shader_path: String = mat.shader.resource_path if mat is ShaderMaterial and mat.shader else ""
163		check("material-on-sprite", mat is ShaderMaterial and mat_shader_path == SHADER_PATH and game.player.material == null and game.player.art.material == null,
164			{"sprite_material": str(mat), "shader": mat_shader_path, "player_material": str(game.player.material), "art_material": str(game.player.art.material)})
165	
166		# --- R1: nothing glows before W ---
167		var pre_n := S().size()
168		var pre_ok := pre_n >= 3
169		for i in range(pre_n):
170			if S()[i].g != 0.0 or S()[i].h:
171				pre_ok = false
172		check("glow-starts-zero", pre_ok, {"frames": pre_n, "last": S()[pre_n - 1] if pre_n > 0 else null})
173	
174		# --- R1, R3, R4, F1 (Revision 3): W through the game loop; ramp from 0 into the band ---
175		# The brief says "into the band within 0.25 s". At the ramp rate 1/RAMP the band's low edge
176		# (0.4) is reached in 0.4 × 0.25 = 0.1 s, asserted to one frame as well, so a slower ramp (F1)
177		# is still caught on the way up now that 1.0 is no longer the target.
178		var press_at := S().size()

188		var i1 := first_from(press_at, func(s): return in_band(s.g))

196		check("ramp-up-time", i0 >= 0 and i1 > i0 and up_time <= RAMP + d + EPS and absf(up_time - up_expected) <= d + EPS and g_max <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS and S()[i_rise].h,

# A5 hose glow (CHANGE-BRIEF Part A): the shader's interface and the driver's rules, headless.
# The hosing state is driven through the real game loop and synthetic key events (W, R), never
# by calling the driver. The uniform is read every frame by a Sampler node whose process_priority
# is high, so it runs after every other _process in the frame (the driver included).
# Run at 30, 60 and 144 fps: scripts/run-test.sh test_hose_glow.gd <fps>.
# Revision 3: the hold is a breathing band 0.4..0.8 with a 1.0 s period instead of a flat 1.0;
# the hold assertions (in-band, maxima, period) and the ramp targets follow it.
# What this cannot see: pixels. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/hose_glow.gdshader"
const DRIVER_PATH := "res://features/player/hose_glow.gd"
const RAMP := 0.25     # R3: ramp rate is 1/RAMP per game second
const BAND_LO := 0.4   # Revision 3: while hosing, glow breathes 0.6 + 0.2 sin(2π t) ...
const BAND_HI := 0.8
const PERIOD := 1.0    # ... with a 1.0 s period in game seconds
const EPS := 1e-5
const BAND_EPS := 1e-4   # membership tolerance for the band
const REACH_EPS := 0.01  # how close the sampled signal must come to 0.4 and 0.8 (sampling at 30 fps loses < 0.002)
var game: Node2D
var sampler: Sampler
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0

# Records {g: glow uniform, d: process delta, h: player.hosing} once per _process frame, after
# everyone else's _process (priority 100). It only reads; it never touches the driver.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game: Node2D
	var samples: Array = []
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null or game.player.sprite == null:
			return
		var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
		var g: float = float(mat.get_shader_parameter("glow")) if mat is ShaderMaterial else -1.0
		samples.append({"g": g, "d": delta, "h": game.player.hosing})

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, the path test_keyboard.gd already proves reaches
# Input.is_action_just_pressed in physics (W) and _unhandled_input (R) headlessly.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
	if not condition:
		failures += 1

func fresh() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(game):
		game.queue_free()
		await process_frame
	game = Game.new()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	game.start_session()          # real input: player.test_control stays false
	sampler.game = game
	sampler.samples.clear()
	game.player.position = Vector2(1220, 240)  # on B1-PW, in hose range (same spot as test_game.gd)
	await steps(3)

func S() -> Array:
	return sampler.samples

func in_band(g: float) -> bool:
	return g >= BAND_LO - BAND_EPS and g <= BAND_HI + BAND_EPS

func zero(g: float) -> bool:
	return is_zero_approx(g)

func first_from(from: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, S().size()):
		if pred.call(S()[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func last_before(limit: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
	var found := -1
	for i in range(0, limit):
		if pred.call(S()[i]):
			found = i
	return found

# Every step between a and b (inclusive) moves in `dir` (+1 up, -1 down), never backwards,
# and by at most delta / RAMP (+ EPS). Returns {ok, worst_step}.
func monotone(a: int, b: int, dir: float) -> Dictionary:
	var ok := a >= 0 and b > a
	var worst := 0.0
	for i in range(a + 1, b + 1):
		var step: float = (S()[i].g - S()[i - 1].g) * dir
		var max_step: float = S()[i].d / RAMP + EPS
		worst = maxf(worst, step)
		if step < -EPS or step > max_step:
			ok = false
	return {"ok": ok, "worst_step": worst}

func all_in_band(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
	if a < 0 or b < a:
		return false
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		if not in_band(S()[i].g):
			return false
	return true

# Indices of the strict local maxima of g in [a, b] (a > 0, b < size - 1). A tie with the next
# sample counts once, on the first of the pair (at 30 fps the peak at t = 0.25 s falls between
# two samples that are equal up to rounding).
func local_maxima(a: int, b: int) -> Array[int]:
	var peaks: Array[int] = []
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), mini(b, S().size() - 2) + 1):
		if S()[i].g > S()[i - 1].g and S()[i].g >= S()[i + 1].g:
			peaks.append(i)
	return peaks

func min_max(a: int, b: int) -> Dictionary:
	var lo := INF
	var hi := -INF
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		lo = minf(lo, S()[i].g)
		hi = maxf(hi, S()[i].g)
	return {"min": lo, "max": hi}

func run() -> void:
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.process_priority = 100

	# --- A2 / F4: the shader's interface, from the engine and from the source text ---
	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var uniforms: Array = shader.get_shader_uniform_list()
	var types := {}
	var raw: Array = []
	for u in uniforms:
		types[String(u.name)] = int(u.type)
		raw.append({"name": String(u.name), "type": int(u.type), "hint": int(u.hint), "hint_string": String(u.hint_string)})
	check("shader-uniforms", uniforms.size() == 2 and types.get("glow", -1) == TYPE_FLOAT and types.get("glow_color", -1) == TYPE_COLOR,
		{"uniforms": raw, "TYPE_FLOAT": TYPE_FLOAT, "TYPE_COLOR": TYPE_COLOR})
	var src: String = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	var re_glow := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+float\\s+glow\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*0\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*0\\.0\\s*;")
	var re_color := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+vec4\\s+glow_color\\s*:\\s*source_color\\s*=\\s*vec4\\(\\s*0\\.6\\s*,\\s*0\\.85\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*,\\s*1\\.0\\s*\\)\\s*;")
	check("shader-defaults", re_glow.search(src) != null and re_color.search(src) != null,
		{"glow_default_line": re_glow.search(src) != null, "glow_color_default_line": re_color.search(src) != null, "source_bytes": src.length()})
	var re_line := RegEx.create_from_string("COLOR\\.rgb\\s*=\\s*mix\\(\\s*COLOR\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow_color\\.rgb\\s*,\\s*glow\\s*\\)\\s*;")
	check("colour-line", re_line.search(src) != null, {"a2_colour_line_present": re_line.search(src) != null})
	var driver_param: String = load(DRIVER_PATH).PARAM
	check("driver-param-declared", types.has(driver_param), {"driver_writes": driver_param, "shader_declares": types.keys()})

	# --- A2 / F5 / R8: where the material sits ---
	await fresh()
	var mat: Material = game.player.sprite.material
	var mat_shader_path: String = mat.shader.resource_path if mat is ShaderMaterial and mat.shader else ""
	check("material-on-sprite", mat is ShaderMaterial and mat_shader_path == SHADER_PATH and game.player.material == null and game.player.art.material == null,

	# The brief says "into the band within 0.25 s". At the ramp rate 1/RAMP the band's low edge
	# (0.4) is reached in 0.4 × 0.25 = 0.1 s, asserted to one frame as well, so a slower ramp (F1)
	# is still caught on the way up now that 1.0 is no longer the target.
	var press_at := S().size()
	key(KEY_W, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(KEY_W, false)
	var guard := 0
	while guard < 200 and first_from(press_at, func(s): return in_band(s.g)) < 0:
		await steps(1)
		guard += 1
	var i_rise := first_from(press_at, func(s): return s.g > 0.0)

1	## A3 headless check of the three props in scenes3d/props_room.tscn.
2	##   timeout 120 godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/check_props.gd --fixed-fps 60
3	##   ... -- mutate     (deliberately breaks the scene in memory: the check must then FAIL all three props)
4	## For each prop it prints, beside my brief (latest CHANGE-BRIEF revision, in Godot axes W x H x D):
5	##   - the GLOBAL bounding box (every MeshInstance3D's AABB pushed through its global transform,
6	##     so a rotated or scaled node cannot hide behind a correct-looking mesh),
7	##   - the scale of the prop node and of every mesh node under it,
8	##   - which world axis the prop's height lies along (Y = upright),
9	##   - the bottom of the prop compared with the floor's surface (sits on it / floats / sinks),
10	##   - the triangle count from the imported index buffers, against my budget.
11	## What it does NOT show: whether the props look right, read as a hydrant / backpack / flame,
12	## have the right colours, or suit the game's style. Those are my human checks.
13	extends SceneTree
14	
15	const TOL := 0.01  # metres
16	const PROPS := {
17		"Hydrant":   {"brief": Vector3(0.40, 0.80, 0.36),  "budget": 400},
18		"RescueBag": {"brief": Vector3(0.36, 0.612, 0.306), "budget": 300},
19		"Flame":     {"brief": Vector3(0.36, 0.62, 0.265),  "budget": 400},
20	}
21	
22	func _initialize() -> void:
23		var scene: Node3D = load("res://scenes3d/props_room.tscn").instantiate()
24		root.add_child(scene)
25		var mutate := "mutate" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
26		if mutate:
27			# Planted faults: the check must catch every one of them.
28			scene.get_node("Hydrant").rotate_z(PI / 2)            # lying on its side (prediction P1)
29			scene.get_node("RescueBag").scale = Vector3(2, 2, 2)  # scale not 1 (wrong size)
30			scene.get_node("Flame").position.y -= 0.2             # sunk into the floor (prediction P2)
31			print("MUTATE MODE: hydrant rotated 90 deg, bag scaled x2, flame lowered 0.2 m")
32		await process_frame
33	
34		var floor: MeshInstance3D = scene.get_node("Floor")
35		var floor_y: float = _global_aabb(floor).end.y   # the top of the floor plane (a flat plane: its top IS its surface)
36		print("Floor surface at y = %.4f (plane %s, its own scale %s)" % [floor_y, floor.mesh.size, floor.scale])
37	
38		var failures := 0
39		for name in PROPS:
40			var node: Node3D = scene.get_node(name)
41			var spec: Dictionary = PROPS[name]
42			var brief: Vector3 = spec.brief
43			var budget: int = spec.budget
44			var box := _global_aabb(node)
45			var size := box.size
46			var scales: Array = [node.scale]
47			var tris := 0
48			for mi in _meshes(node):
49				scales.append(mi.global_transform.basis.get_scale())
50				tris += _triangles(mi.mesh)
51			var all_one: bool = scales.all(func(s): return s.is_equal_approx(Vector3.ONE))
52			var tallest: String = "X" if size.x >= size.y and size.x >= size.z else ("Y" if size.y >= size.z else "Z")
53			var bottom_gap: float = box.position.y - floor_y
54			var on_floor: bool = absf(bottom_gap) <= TOL
55			var diff: Vector3 = (size - brief).abs()
56			var size_ok: bool = diff.x <= TOL and diff.y <= TOL and diff.z <= TOL
57			var upright: bool = tallest == "Y" and node.global_transform.basis.y.normalized().is_equal_approx(Vector3.UP)
58			var ok: bool = size_ok and all_one and upright and on_floor and tris <= budget
59			if not ok:
60				failures += 1
61			print("%-9s | size W×H×D %.3f × %.3f × %.3f m (brief %.3f × %.3f × %.3f) %s | scale %s | height along %s %s | bottom %+.4f m vs floor %s | tris %d / %d %s | %s" % [
62				name, size.x, size.y, size.z, brief.x, brief.y, brief.z, "ok" if size_ok else "OFF",
63				"1,1,1" if all_one else str(scales), tallest, "(upright)" if upright else "(NOT upright)",
64				bottom_gap, "on it" if on_floor else ("FLOATS" if bottom_gap > 0 else "SINKS"),
65				tris, budget, "ok" if tris <= budget else "OVER", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"])
66		print("RESULT: %s (%d of %d props failing)%s" % ["PASS" if failures == 0 else "FAIL", failures, PROPS.size(), " [mutate mode]" if mutate else ""])
67		quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)
68	
69	func _meshes(n: Node) -> Array:
70		var out: Array = []
71		if n is MeshInstance3D:
72			out.append(n)
73		for c in n.get_children():
74			out.append_array(_meshes(c))
75		return out
76	
77	func _global_aabb(n: Node) -> AABB:
78		var box := AABB()
79		var first := true
80		for mi in _meshes(n):
81			var a: AABB = mi.mesh.get_aabb()
82			for i in 8:
83				var p: Vector3 = mi.global_transform * a.get_endpoint(i)
84				if first:
85					box = AABB(p, Vector3.ZERO)
86					first = false
87				else:
88					box = box.expand(p)
89		return box
90	
91	func _triangles(mesh: Mesh) -> int:
92		var t := 0
93		for s in mesh.get_surface_count():
94			var arrays: Array = mesh.surface_get_arrays(s)
95			var idx = arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
96			t += (idx.size() if idx != null else arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX].size()) / 3
97		return t
